description: Election Commission - List of Officers who proposed to be appointed as Assistant Returning Officers for the purpose of Local Govt. Election 2018
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the appointment of Assistant Returning Officers for Local Authorities Elections across administrative districts. It is issued by the Election Commission under Section 27(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it directly related to electoral processes and administration, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
